Ingest a dataset registered in the Gaia catalog

Source: R/catalog.R
ingestDatasource.Rd

Runs backbone.ingest_datasource(): loads the dataset's JSON-LD metadata, downloads the source data and loads it into PostGIS, then cleans the geometry and adds the local projection.

Usage

ingestDatasource(connection, tableId, shell = "/bin/sh")

Arguments

connection

A connection from connectGaia().

tableId

Catalog identifier of the dataset, for example "us_2014_2019_monthly_pm25_by_county_cdc".

shell

Shell used by the database to run the dataset's ETL scripts.

Value

Invisibly, a data frame with one row per ingestion step (step, status, message). An error is raised if a step failed.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ingestDatasource(connection, "us_2023_county_tl")
ingestDatasource(connection, "us_2014_2019_monthly_pm25_by_county_cdc")
} # }
